decisions.decision: It was decided to fill out the board overview worksheet and make it available on the website for the public.

decisions.decision: Each board was requested to submit the overview form back to the Selectmen office.
decisions.quote: each board was requested to submit the form back to the selectmen office.

decisions.decision: The Board will meet on Monday, October 23rd instead of its regular meeting night, to attend an opioid informational forum.
decisions.quote: the board will meet on monday, october 23rd due to them attending an opioid informational forum on their regular meeting night.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Walker said the money received from Comcast is basically a pass-through, at about $2.70 per subscriber per month, and the committee is requesting an increase in the cable fee.
budget_items.quote: at this moment, it's about $2.70 per subscriber per month.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed an accounts payable warrant for a stated amount.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $518,957.94.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Parks Commission said fees for town beach passes and swim lessons have not increased in almost ten years and it will keep evaluating fees.
budget_items.quote: for almost ten years we haven't seen an increase in the fees for town beach passes and swim lessons.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Parks Commission said the town beach coordinator and lifeguard positions had to be added to the salary administration plan.
budget_items.quote: we found our town beach coordinator and lifeguard positions needed to be added to the salary administration plan.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board of Assessors said a contract to identify personal property valuations may uncover significant potential revenue.
budget_items.quote: we believe there is a lot of potential revenue out there.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Council on Aging said Friday openings happened without increasing the budget, and it lists future staffing funding as a need.
budget_items.quote: they are now open on fridays thanks to the eagle house supporters and without increasing the budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager said the town website overhaul is being funded through a Community Compact grant.
budget_items.quote: we are going to be overhauling the town website through community compact grant funding.
